caption: The drawing features a single glass vase positioned centrally within a lightly outlined rectangular border. The vase is rendered in shades of green with hints of yellow, with areas highlighted in white and blue to indicate reflections and transparency. It has a flared rim, a narrow neck, and a bulbous body that tapers into a flat, circular base. On either side near the base, there are small, angular glass handles depicted with a faceted appearance. The background is plain and off-white, with a slight shadow cast by the vase to the right, and there is a faint brown stain below the vase inside the border. The artist's signature, "Bimline," is visible in the bottom right corner inside the outlined border.
title: Vase
